summary: Pharaoh changed his mind and chased the Israelites with his army. Trapped between the sea and the chariots, the people panicked, but Moses said, 'Don't be afraid. Stand still and see what Yahweh will do.'

story_reel.narration: Back in Egypt, Pharaoh changed his mind again. 'What have we done? We let our slaves go!' He got into his chariot and took six hundred of his best chariots, plus all the other chariots of Egypt, and chased after the Israelites. God's people were camped by the Red Sea. When they looked up and saw the Egyptian army thundering toward them, they were terrified. The sea was in front of them, and the army was behind them. They were trapped! The people cried out to God, and they also yelled at Moses: 'Weren't there enough graves in Egypt? Why did you bring us out here to die? We should have stayed!' But Moses answered with faith: 'Don't be afraid! Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which He will do for you today. The Egyptians you see today, you will never see again. Yahweh will fight for you. You only need to be still.' When you're trapped and scared, remember Moses' words. God is bigger than whatever is chasing you.

memory_verse.text: Don't be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh

identity_focus.core_truth: I don't have to be afraid, because Yahweh is bigger than anything chasing me.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: The Israelites felt trapped between the sea and the army. Is there a situation where you feel stuck or scared?

quiz.question: How many of his best chariots did Pharaoh take?
quiz.explanation: Pharaoh took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt.

quiz.question: What did the people say to Moses when they saw the army?
options: 'Why did you bring us out here to die?'
quiz.explanation: They said, 'Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness?'

quiz.question: What did Moses tell the people to do?
options: Don't be afraid. Stand still and see God's salvation
quiz.explanation: Moses said, 'Don't be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, when I feel trapped and scared, help me not to be afraid. Help me stand still and trust that You are bigger than anything I face. Amen.

companion.message: I was so scared that day. The sea was in front of us and the army was behind us. But my brother's voice was calm. He knew God would make a way.
